highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 delivers the Skia m150 engine update with new rendering APIs and runtime improvements.
highlights_body: It adds culling, image-filter, and overdraw APIs, improves canvas wrapper performance, fixes raster blur behavior, and updates HarfBuzz.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 150 and includes the matching upstream stability fixes.

bullets.lead: New culling, overdraw, and image-filter APIs
bullets.detail: Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds, SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw, and crop and empty SKImageFilter factories.
Avoids a slow raster blur pipeline regression that could affect the appearance and performance of small blur radii.
Repeated Canvas access avoids unnecessary wrapper allocation while preserving the same managed canvas instance.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Canvas wrapper performance work, raster blur correction, and v4 API cleanup

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m150 release line.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the m150 engine update, HarfBuzz refresh, and v4 cleanup work.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate added culling, overdraw, image-filter APIs, canvas reuse, and the raster blur fix.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native stack to 14.2.1.
